claims.claim: A service to a foreign resident is zero-rated (0% VAT) under Section 30(a)(5), subject to its exclusions, of the Israeli VAT Law, legally distinct from exempt (patur, Sec 31). In the Morning API a 0% line is set via the income-row vatRate field (decimal 0), not a vatType value. The DOCUMENT-level enum DocumentVatType is 0=Default, 1=Exempt, 2=Mixed; the INCOME-ROW enum is a different one, ItemVatType, where 0=Default, 1=Included (VAT included in price), 2=Exempt.
